verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense docs confirm budgets, virtual cards, custom approval policies, and card/expense controls tied to AI-powered spend management, supporting budget allocation and enforcement via cards and approvals. However, evidence lacks detail on project-level budget allocation granularity, real-time overspend blocking mechanics, or hands-on/independent verification that limits actually hard-block transactions in practice. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time enforcement, project-level (not just team/org) budget breakdown, and detail on how approval policies interact with card limits at transaction time.
